generic_name: Glandula Suprarenalis (Bovine), Hepar (Bovine), Histaminum Hydrochloricum, Alternaria Tenuis Nees, Aspergillus Niger, Candida Albicans, Candida Parapsilosis, Dust, Mucor Racemosus, Torula Cerevisiae, House Dust Mite, Adrenocorticotrophin, Rhizopus Nigricans
purpose: This product is used to help relieve symptoms related to allergies and sensitivities, including reactions to molds, dust, yeast, and environmental allergens. It may help reduce symptoms like sneezing, runny nose, itchy eyes, and general allergy discomfort. It is also sometimes used to support immune system balance in people who react to common environmental triggers.
how_it_works: This is a homeopathic medicine, which means it contains very tiny, highly diluted amounts of substances that in larger doses might cause allergy-like symptoms — the idea is that these tiny amounts help teach your body to stop overreacting to them. It also includes diluted extracts from adrenal gland and liver tissue, which homeopathic practitioners believe may help support your body's natural stress and immune responses. Think of it like gently nudging your immune system to become less sensitive over time.
common_side_effects: This product is generally considered well tolerated. Some people may briefly notice a mild temporary worsening of their allergy symptoms when first starting — this is sometimes called a 'healing response' in homeopathy. Mild skin irritation at the site of application (if used as a topical or injection form) is possible. Digestive upset is rarely reported.
warnings: Talk to your doctor before using this product if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or have a serious immune system condition. If you have a known severe allergy (anaphylaxis) to any of the listed ingredients such as mold, dust mites, or yeast, use with extreme caution and only under medical supervision. Do not use this as a replacement for prescribed allergy medications or emergency epinephrine without consulting your healthcare provider. This product has not been evaluated or approved by the FDA to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. Keep out of reach of children.
typical_dosing: Dosing varies depending on the specific product form (oral drops, sublingual tablets, or injectable). A typical oral homeopathic dose is 10 to 15 drops placed under the tongue two to three times daily, or as directed by your healthcare provider. Always follow the label instructions or your doctor's guidance, and do not exceed the recommended dose. If you miss a dose, simply take the next one at the regular time — do not double up.
